description: The tiny Mars Helicopter Ingenuity has flown into our hearts. Project manager MiMi Aung and her team may have made it look easy, but Aung explains why it was anything but. Bruce Betts has tips for viewing the upcoming total lunar eclipse. Planetary Radio t-shirts are back as prizes in the space trivia contest! And we’ve got space headlines from The Downlink, our weekly newsletter. Discover more at https://www.planetary.org/planetary-radio/mimi-aung-ingenuity-update See omnystudio.com/listener fo…
classificationReason: In-depth interview with the project manager of NASA's Ingenuity Mars helicopter, an autonomous robotic aerial vehicle.
qualityReason: Original expert interview focused on the technical difficulty of developing and operating Ingenuity.
